dataformat.name: groovyXml
dataformat.title: Groovy XML
dataformat.description: Transform between XML and Groovy Node (Map structure) objects
dataformat.label: dataformat,transformation,xml

marshalIn.description: A Groovy Node or GPathResult, a Map or a Jackson JsonNode to write as XML. Text, bytes, a stream or a file is written as it is

marshalOut.description: The XML in the stream cache, or a byte array when stream caching is off

unmarshalOut.description: The XML parsed into a Groovy Node

attributeMapping.description: Whether to enable attribute mapping. When enabled, keys that start with _ or character will be mapped to an XML attribute, and vice versa.
